env.already: {lang} already installed via {method} — nothing to do.
env.docker_usage: to use the image, run in your project:
env.method_required: no --method given. available here: {methods}. pick one with --method.
env.method_unavailable: method '{method}' is not available on this machine ({reason})
env.method_unknown: unknown method: {method} (use: docker | mise | distro | official)
env.mise_bootstrap: mise not found — it will be installed first via https://mise.run (curl | sh).
env.na_freebsd_method: '{method}' is not available for {lang} on FreeBSD. Use: install {lang} --method distro (pkg).
env.na_freebsd_method_any: method '{method}' is not available on FreeBSD — use --method distro (pkg).
env.na_freebsd_no_root: pkg needs root, and neither sudo nor doas was found. Run as root, or install one of them (pkg install sudo).
env.na_tool_freebsd: {tool} has no official FreeBSD build (its installer supports only Linux, macOS and Windows). Use it on one of those systems.
env.no_tty: no terminal to confirm; run again with -y to proceed (or --dry-run to just see the plan)
env.path_already: ~/.local/bin is already configured on your PATH — reopen your terminal OR run: source ~/.bashrc
env.path_fix_failed: could not update a shell rc file ({error}) — add this line manually: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
env.path_fixed: added ~/.local/bin to your PATH (~/.bashrc + ~/.profile) — reopen your terminal OR run: source ~/.bashrc
env.ready_missing: warning: {bin} did not appear on your PATH nor in ~/.local/bin — the install may have failed. re-run with --dry-run to inspect the commands, or check the output above.
env.remove_no_method: no --method and couldn't detect how {lang} was installed. pick with --method.
env.tag_pipe: [downloads and pipes to a shell — remote code]
env.tool_already: {tool} already installed (found in PATH) — nothing to do.
env.tool_method_ignored: {tool} is a dev tool: --method '{method}' is ignored (it has a single canonical install path).
env.tools_header: dev tools (own install path — --method is ignored):
env.unknown_lang: unknown environment: {lang} (try: go, rust, elixir, csharp, zig, ruby, node)
install.all_intro: I will install the {n} ecosystem apps: {apps}
install.what_missing: say what to install (e.g. `install go`) or use `--all`
market.broken: broken — it is there but does not respond
up.ahead: {bin}: v{installed} is ahead of the published release (v{published}) - kept.
up.app_uptodate: The app is already at the target version (v{target}).
up.comp_failed: warning: build of {bin} failed (optional, moving on): {error}
up.comp_uptodate: {bin} is already at the target version (v{version}).
up.method_bad: warning: install-method record unreadable ({error}) - inferring from the binary.
up.no_ecosystem: no ecosystem app installed; run `schematize-market install --all` to install the apps (deployer, optimizer, database, git, skills, overdev)
up.no_target: could not resolve the target version (network/GitHub unavailable?).
up.pin_cleared: pin removed - following the latest published.
up.plan_skipped: not installed -> skipped (updating does not install)
up.release_not_found: ? (repository not found on GitHub - private or nonexistent)
up.self_failed: warning: could not update myself ({error}) - the current one still works.
